title: Grateful Dead Live at L'Olympia on 1972-05-03
lineage: MR > DAT x 5 > Audiophile 2496 > Samplitude v7.02 Professional > FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑energy May ’72 Olympia show with a smoking Other One and Me & My Uncle, captured on a solid soundboard despite a brief Casey Jones glitch.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently praised as one of the tour’s highlights – the first set is described as supernaturally tight with standout moments like Me & My Uncle, China Cat > Rider and an inspired Other One sandwich. The soundboard source is generally clear, though reviewers note a minor glitch on Casey Jones and some overdub artifacts, but these do not detract from the overall listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews uniformly rate the show 5 stars for musical excellence; recording is rated good with only minor issues, yielding a combined high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear and well‑balanced soundboard capture. Notable glitch on Casey Jones (4:25‑4:30) and occasional overdub artifacts (ghost vox on Jack Straw), but the mix is crisp for the rest of the set.

standout_songs: The Other One > Me & My Uncle > Bobby McGee
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Beat It On Down the Line
Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon 4‑hour concert with a tightly locked first set and a second set that stays strong despite a few looser moments; transitions flow well and the overall pacing keeps the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for insane fills, wah‑pedal work, double bends, but noted a brief loss of two rounds on Casey Jones; his guitar drives many highlights.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as "ON" during He's Gone and launching the rumble in The Other One, providing powerful bass support.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is highlighted as being on‑point throughout (especially on He's Gone), adding rich keyboard texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann noted for rapid 32nd‑note tom rolls on Not Fade Away; overall drumming tight and energetic.
